steps.title: Getting started
steps.text: Talk to Benedict in a house north-west of the Varrock lodestone.

steps.title: All players
steps.text: Travel to Varrock Palace. Go to the north-west staircase and then to the top floor to collect the fox pelt.
Head to the roof of Al Kharid Palace and collect the toffee apple.

Head to Het's Oasis and go to the statue in the centre to collect the package.
  • Teleport there with a ring of duelling.
  • If you are below 65 Agility, run north around the whirligig pool to cross the fallen palm tree, which has no Agility requirement.

Enter the low-level Runespan portal to collect the crystal to the south-west (on the same island you start on).
  • Teleport there with the wicked hood or stardust.

Head to Mudskipper Point and head south-west to collect the toy ship.
  • Use a fairy Ring AIQ or the Port Sarim lodestone to teleport there
Head to the 2nd floor[UK]3rd floor[US] of Lumbridge Castle and collect a pipe by the north stairs.
Head to the west side of the White Knights' Castle in Falador, and climb the stairs and ladders to the roof to collect a monocle.

Head to the beacon south of Paterdomus to collect a scarf.
  • Teleport there with either the Skeletal horror Teleport, an invitation box, a Fort Forinthry Teleport, an Archaeology journal.
  • Alternatively, teleport there with a Dig Site pendant to the Varrock Dig Site.
Teleport to Ashdale lodestone and head directly south to collect the surgical mask.

steps.title: Members-only
steps.text:
Head to White Wolf Mountain and collect the raw fish-like thing, which is right next to the glider.
  • Ride on the gnome glider of Captain Dalbur from Al Kharid.

Head to the Grand Tree and head south of the 2nd floor[UK]3rd floor[US] to collect a flask of tea.
  • Ride on the gnome glider.
  • Alternatively, teleport via spirit trees.

Head to Castle Wars, then head north-west of the portals, and walk on to the spectating wall to collect the sweets.
  • Teleport with a ring of duelling.

Enter the Polypore Dungeon and go slightly east to collect cinnamon, which is next to the neem drupe branch.
  • Use a fairy Ring BIP to teleport there.
  • Alternatively, the Dungeoneering cape teleport (0, 7) or
  • Delver's anklet (3) can be used.
Head to the top floor of the Sorcerer's Tower north-east of Ardougne to collect a money pouch.
Teleport to Anachronia lodestone to collect the foot slightly south-east of the lodestone.

Head north of the Menaphos gates to pass through the world window and continue slightly north to collect the frogburger.
  • If you did not finish the dialog with Benedict, talk to him again to complete the miniquest.
